description: All new service screens (12 generic + 2 notable-persons + 2 tourism + 1 gallery + 1 upazila detail) plus news rewrite + blood donor pull-to-refresh. Depends on FEAT-001 (models, services, widgets) and FEAT-002 (router has been updated). Independent of FEAT-002 screens themselves.
steps:
1. Create the 12 generic service screens. Each follows this pattern (study lib/screens/hospitals/hospitals_screen.dart for the exact code shape):
   - file-level StreamProvider using GenericServiceService().getItems(collectionName, ...)
   - file-level StateProviders for filter values
   - ConsumerWidget Scaffold with AppBar title
   - FilterChipRow or upazila filter at top
   - RefreshIndicator wrapping content
   - Expanded body: async.when(loading:ShimmerList(8), error:EmptyState(retry), data: list.isEmpty?EmptyState(...):ListView of InfoCard)

   Create these 12 files:
   a) `lib/screens/pharmacy/pharmacy_screen.dart` — title:'ফার্মেসি', collection: AppConstants.colPharmacies, filter: upazilaId via upazila FilterChipRow (13 options: সব + 12 upazilas from AppConstants.upazilas), icon:Icons.local_pharmacy_rounded, iconColor:Color(0xFF059669)
   b) `lib/screens/education/education_screen.dart` — title:'শিক্ষা প্রতিষ্ঠান', collection: AppConstants.colEducation, filter by type: [('','সব'),('school','স্কুল'),('college','কলেজ'),('madrasa','মাদ্রাসা'),('university','বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়'),('kindergarten','কিন্ডারগার্টেন')], icon:Icons.school_rounded, iconColor:Color(0xFF7C3AED)
   c) `lib/screens/transport/transport_screen.dart` — title:'যানবাহন', collection: AppConstants.colTransport, filter by type: [('','সব'),('bus','বাস'),('launch','লঞ্চ'),('train','ট্রেন'),('cng','সিএনজি'),('rental','ভাড়া')], icon:Icons.directions_bus_rounded, iconColor:Color(0xFFD97706)
   d) `lib/screens/finance/finance_screen.dart` — title:'ব্যাংক ও আর্থিক সেবা', collection: AppConstants.colFinance, filter by type: [('','সব'),('bank','ব্যাংক'),('insurance','বীমা'),('ngo','এনজিও'),('mfs','মোবাইল ব্যাংকিং')], icon:Icons.account_balance_rounded, iconColor:Color(0xFF1D4ED8)
   e) `lib/screens/business/business_screen.dart` — title:'ব্যবসা প্রতিষ্ঠান', collection: AppConstants.colBusinesses, filter by upazilaId, icon:Icons.storefront_rounded, iconColor:Color(0xFF0066CC)
   f) `lib/screens/govt/govt_screen.dart` — title:'সরকারি সেবা', collection: AppConstants.colGovtServices, filter by type: [('','সব'),('upazila','উপজেলা পরিষদ'),('union','ইউনিয়ন পরিষদ'),('office','সরকারি অফিস')], icon:Icons.account_balance_rounded, iconColor:Color(0xFF006A4E)
   g) `lib/screens/police/police_screen.dart` — title:'পুলিশ স্টেশন', collection: AppConstants.colPoliceStations, NO type filter; at top of body BEFORE the list: Container(margin:16, child:ElevatedButton.icon(onPressed:call999, icon:Icons.local_police_rounded, label:Text('জাতীয় পুলিশ হেল্পলাইন: 999'), style:red bg, padding:v16, full width)); then InfoCard list, icon:Icons.local_police_rounded, iconColor:Color(0xFF1D4ED8)
   h) `lib/screens/electricity/electricity_screen.dart` — title:'বিদ্যুৎ অফিস', collection: AppConstants.colElectricityOffices, NO filter, icon:Icons.electric_bolt_rounded, iconColor:Color(0xFFF59E0B)
   i) `lib/screens/islamic/islamic_screen.dart` — title:'মসজিদ ও ধর্মীয় স্থান', collection: AppConstants.colIslamic, filter by type: [('','সব'),('mosque','মসজিদ'),('temple','মন্দির'),('church','চার্চ')]; at top of body (before filter row) include PrayerTimesStrip() inside a Card; icon:Icons.mosque_rounded, iconColor:Color(0xFF006A4E)
   j) `lib/screens/professionals/professionals_screen.dart` — title:'পেশাদার সেবা', collection: AppConstants.colProfessionals, filter by type: [('','সব'),('lawyer','আইনজীবী'),('accountant','হিসাবরক্ষক'),('engineer','প্রকৌশলী'),('it','আইটি বিশেষজ্ঞ'),('doctor','চিকিৎসক')], icon:Icons.badge_rounded, iconColor:Color(0xFF7C3AED)
   k) `lib/screens/organizations/organizations_screen.dart` — title:'সংগঠন ও ক্লাব', collection: AppConstants.colOrganizations, NO type filter, filter by upazilaId, icon:Icons.groups_rounded, iconColor:Color(0xFF059669)
   l) `lib/screens/jobs/jobs_screen.dart` — title:'চাকরির বিজ্ঞপ্তি', collection: AppConstants.colJobs, NO filter. Each InfoCard shows deadline from description field; if description contains 'deadline:YYYY-MM-DD', parse and show red badge 'শেষ তারিখ: DD MMM' if within 7 days else grey badge. icon:Icons.work_rounded, iconColor:Color(0xFF0066CC)

2. Create `lib/screens/notable_persons/notable_persons_screen.dart`:
   - title:'বিশিষ্ট ব্যক্তিবর্গ'
   - file-level StreamProvider on Firestore AppConstants.colNotablePersons orderBy('name') → List<NotablePersonModel>
   - file-level StateProvider<String> for category filter
   - FilterChipRow for categories: [('','সব'),('politician','রাজনীতিবিদ'),('artist','শিল্পী'),('writer','সাহিত্যিক'),('scientist','বিজ্ঞানী'),('freedom_fighter','মুক্তিযোদ্ধা'),('other','অন্যান্য')]
   - Body: GridView.count(crossAxisCount:2) of person cards: CachedNetworkImage(height:140, fit:cover) + Container(padding:8)[Text(name,14,bold), Text(designation,11,grey)]. Tapping → context.push('/notable-persons/{id}')

3. Create `lib/screens/notable_persons/notable_person_detail_screen.dart`:
   - FutureProvider.family for single doc fetch from colNotablePersons
   - CustomScrollView with SliverAppBar(expandedHeight:250, hero image or placeholder)
   - SliverToBoxAdapter: name (headlineLarge), designation badge, birthYear chip, Divider, bio text (bodyMedium, height:1.6)

4. Create `lib/screens/tourism/tourism_screen.dart`:
   - title:'পর্যটন স্থান'
   - StreamProvider on Firestore AppConstants.colTourism orderBy('name') → List<TourismModel>
   - FilterChipRow: [('','সব'),('historical','ঐতিহাসিক'),('natural','প্রাকৃতিক'),('religious','ধর্মীয়'),('recreational','বিনোদন')]
   - Body: ListView of TourismCard: CachedNetworkImage(width:full, height:180, fit:cover, borderRadius:top12) + Padding(12)[name bold, Row[category badge, Spacer, address icon+text]]. Tapping → context.push('/tourism/{id}')

5. Create `lib/screens/tourism/tourism_detail_screen.dart`:
   - FutureProvider.family single doc fetch from colTourism
   - CustomScrollView: SliverAppBar(expandedHeight:240, hero image)
   - SliverToBoxAdapter: name headlineLarge, category badge, Divider, address row, openingHours row (Icons.access_time), entryFee row (Icons.confirmation_number), SizedBox(16), description bodyMedium

6. Create `lib/screens/gallery/gallery_screen.dart`:
   - title:'ফটো গ্যালারি'
   - StreamProvider on Firestore AppConstants.colGallery orderBy('createdAt',desc) → List<GalleryItemModel>
   - FilterChipRow for category
   - Body: GridView.count(crossAxisCount:3, crossAxisSpacing:2, mainAxisSpacing:2) of CachedNetworkImage(fit:cover). Tapping an image: Navigator.push a full-screen Scaffold with single image + Hero(tag:item.id) + AppBar showing caption

7. Create `lib/screens/upazila/upazila_detail_screen.dart`:
   - Accepts `String upazilaId` path param
   - Looks up upazila data from AppConstants.upazilas list
   - Hardcode union lists per upazila inline as a static Map<String,List<String>> — example for tangail_sadar: ['সদর মডেল ইউনিয়ন','পোড়াইল','ঘারিন্দা','মাহমুদনগর',...]
   - Scaffold AppBar title = upazila name
   - Body Column: hero banner (green gradient card showing name + area + union count), SectionHeader('ইউনিয়ন সমূহ'), ListView of union names, Divider, Row of 3 shortcut buttons: 'হাসপাতাল'→/hospitals, 'ডাক্তার'→/doctors, 'রক্তদাতা'→/blood-donors (each uses context.push with query param but since go_router needs extra, just navigate to the route — the filter selection can be done on the target screen)

8. Rewrite `lib/screens/news/news_screen.dart`: Add DefaultTabController(length:2) wrapping the Scaffold. AppBar bottom: TabBar(tabs:[Tab(text:'খবর'), Tab(text:'নোটিশ')], indicatorColor:white). Body: TabBarView with 2 children:
   - Tab 0 (খবর): StreamBuilder on NewsService().getNews(limit:30) where isNotice==false — use existing NewsCard, add RefreshIndicator wrapping ListView
   - Tab 1 (নোটিশ): StreamBuilder on NewsService().getNotices(limit:30) — same NewsCard with RefreshIndicator
   Remove old category chip row. Keep newsStreamProvider for backward compatibility (home screen uses it).

9. Update `lib/screens/blood_donor/blood_donor_screen.dart`: wrap the Expanded ListView.builder with RefreshIndicator(onRefresh: () async { ref.refresh(bloodDonorsProvider({...})); await Future.delayed(Duration(milliseconds:500)); }). No other changes.

10. Update `lib/config/router.dart`: add imports for all new screens. Add routes outside ShellRoute:
    GoRoute(path:'/pharmacy', builder:..PharmacyScreen())
    GoRoute(path:'/education', builder:..EducationScreen())
    GoRoute(path:'/transport', builder:..TransportScreen())
    GoRoute(path:'/finance', builder:..FinanceScreen())
    GoRoute(path:'/business', builder:..BusinessScreen())
    GoRoute(path:'/govt', builder:..GovtScreen())
    GoRoute(path:'/police', builder:..PoliceScreen())
    GoRoute(path:'/electricity', builder:..ElectricityScreen())
    GoRoute(path:'/islamic', builder:..IslamicScreen())
    GoRoute(path:'/professionals', builder:..ProfessionalsScreen())
    GoRoute(path:'/organizations', builder:..OrganizationsScreen())
    GoRoute(path:'/jobs', builder:..JobsScreen())
    GoRoute(path:'/notable-persons', builder:..NotablePersonsScreen())
    GoRoute(path:'/notable-persons/:id', builder:(_, state)=>NotablePersonDetailScreen(personId:state.pathParameters['id']!))
    GoRoute(path:'/tourism', builder:..TourismScreen())
    GoRoute(path:'/tourism/:id', builder:(_, state)=>TourismDetailScreen(tourismId:state.pathParameters['id']!))
    GoRoute(path:'/gallery', builder:..GalleryScreen())
    GoRoute(path:'/upazila/:id', builder:(_, state)=>UpazilaDetailScreen(upazilaId:state.pathParameters['id']!))

Used ref.invalidate() instead of ref.refresh() to avoid unused_result warnings. Pre-existing warnings in FEAT-001/002 files (doctors_screen unused import, emergency_screen unused fields, hospital_detail_screen const constructors) were left untouched per instructions. All acceptance criteria met: news_screen uses DefaultTabController(2 tabs), police_screen has 999 button, islamic_screen has PrayerTimesStrip, all routes added to router.dart.
